transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. To start, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. It’s best to avoid strenuous work or heavy lifting for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s good to know, thank you. Another question I have is about sensitivity to bright light. I'm very sensitive to it. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things look brighter, sunglasses outside can help.

But strong light sensitivity, especially if your eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things look brighter, sunglasses outside can help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for the vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, thank you. You've been very helpful. I don't have any more questions.

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "A bit of sensitivity to light can be normal...". However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed. The agent was interrupted before it could deliver the full message regarding red-flag symptoms.
